editorial.blurb: Tuco and Blondie is a vibrant Mexican-American spot on Southport where exceptional service and craveable classics like tacos, enchiladas, and margaritas make every visit feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Order during Chicago Restaurant Week for outstanding value ($45 for margarita, appetizer, entrée, and dessert), and ask your server about gluten-free and dairy-free modifications—the staff knows the menu inside and out.
